generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor of at least one contract pertaining to similar work of Supply/providing and commissioning of track chain assembly to Dozers of Govt. sector/ Power utilities/Mining Agencies/Mining contractors/Pvt Ltd companies/reputed organizations. In proof of the above, Work order/ Job order & work done certificate/work completion certificate for the same with contract value not less than Rs.19.27 Lakhs (Excluding GST) during any one year in the last preceding five financial years issued from competent authority should be furnished. The intended bidder shall upload the scanned copy of satisfactory work done certificate/work completion certificate along with Work order/Job order issued from competent authority. (Work done certificate/work order/ purchase order/ job order of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work done certificate/work completion certificate along with Work order/Job order issued from competent authority

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have an average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.38.54 lakhs (Excluding GST.) in any of the two years of preceding five financial years. Bidder should upload the scanned copy of original latest audited balance sheets including profit and loss account/turn over certificates for preceding five completed financial years duly countersigned by chartered accountant as documentary evidence. (Financial turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.)
